card.name: Linking words before "history of"
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or" and "with" right before an expected "history of" or "prior" phrase, mostly in contraindication lists ("current or history of", "patients with a history of").

modes.label: "or" after current/now
modes.description: The word "or" after "current" or "now", where "history" or "prior" comes next.
modes.example: - Have current<< or>> history of deep vein thrombosis or

modes.label: "with" after patients
modes.description: The word "with" after "contraindicated in patients" or "jurisdictions", leading into "a history of".
modes.example: • XULTOPHY 100/3.6 is contraindicated in patients<< with>> a personal or family history of MTC

card.writes: It suppresses "history" and similar tokens, so the model is steered away from writing "history" at this spot.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before "history of" in warnings, such as "current or" or "patients with".
